chunking.strategy: section bounded paragraph groups, grouped atomic table rows, contextual captions, page context for uncaptioned images, and visually extracted model diagrams

diagram_extraction.acceptance_rule: status is ok and contains_target_diagram is true
diagram_extraction.candidate_rule: matching caption evidence, plus uncaptioned images from reports whose title names SysML, Capella, or Arcadia

selection_rule: screening_decision starts with include_, case insensitive; already_included is excluded
